# ZigZag Agile Learning Community

> A self-directed learning community in Asheville, North Carolina (24 Thompson Rd, Asheville, NC 28806) for homeschooled and unschooled kids ages 4-18, running since 2015. Kids choose their own classes, projects and play, Tuesday to Thursday, 9:30 am to 3:30 pm, on a mini-campus with a treehouse, pond, creek, field, kitchen, workshop and art studio. ZigZag is part of the international Agile Learning Centers (ALC) network. It is a drop-off program, not a school: kids 7 and older must be registered NC homeschoolers.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://zigzagalc.org/): what ZigZag is
- [How It Works](https://zigzagalc.org/how-it-works/): a typical day, pods, classes and field trips
- [About Us](https://zigzagalc.org/about-us/): values, people and campus
- [Classes](https://zigzagalc.org/classes/): this semester's class schedule
- [Events](https://zigzagalc.org/events/): open houses and community events
- [FAQs](https://zigzagalc.org/faqs/): self-directed education, tuition, college, mixed ages, NC homeschool rules
- [Contact and tours](https://zigzagalc.org/contact/): ask a question or schedule a tour
